techniques.name: 单张照片竖屏适配与模糊背景
techniques.intent: 保留照片主体比例，使用同图模糊填充竖屏上下空隙。
pitfalls: Exact legacy blur2 kernel/intensity is unknown; do not map it to sigma2 automatically.
Foreground must preserve displayed aspect ratio; filling the entire canvas by stretching changes faces.
The demonstrated11.8seconds is a result of selected music, not a universal template duration.
validation: Check output9:16 dimensions, foreground aspect and absence of unintended black bars.
Inspect background for distracting enlarged details and foreground for clipping.
Video and music end at the intended same timeline time.

techniques.name: 按语音提示排列祝福文字并处理末句动画
techniques.intent: 把每条可替换祝福分配到音乐提示区间，末句保留到结束。

timing.rule: Wishes occupy adjacent chosen cue intervals; final wish starts at final cue and ends at picture end. Intro date/sticker ends at first wish start.

pitfalls: Copying a layer also copies unwanted exit animation; the tutorial explicitly removes it for the final title.
Preset scale curves and exact timing fractions are unknown.
ASR cannot establish exact audible cue locations; no audio was auditioned here.
Birthday date and example wishes are inputs, not facts about the current user.
validation: Verify text content and dates before rendering.
Inspect every cue boundary and entrance/hold/exit at full size.
Final title remains present through intended final frame and no inherited shrink hides it.
Audition cue synchronization and the narrated1.5-second music-tail fade if used.

techniques.name: 日期贴纸、整体氛围和尾部彩带分层定时
techniques.intent: 把装饰组织为有明确开始与结束的独立图层。

timing.rule: Resolve intervals from the actual title/cue timeline; do not hard-code tutorial dates or source-video lesson timestamps as output timing.

pitfalls: Exact animated sticker/confetti assets require provenance; generic replacements are approximations.
An intro date must be confirmed, not copied from historical tutorial footage.
Full-frame effects can cover faces and text or violate a simpler user style preference.
validation: Check intro and all decorative interval boundaries.
Inspect facial visibility, date readability and final title under confetti.
Verify no unintentional visual gap or abrupt decorative cut at interval handoffs.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified; exact musical onsets, several font/effect names and source music licensing remain unknown.
Legacy blur strength and animation interpolation are not calibrated.
